links.why: cl1 is a weqatal whose waw is fused into the verb form, so the link is 'and then' (continuation of the same assertion), not a plain 'and'. The sense is a second line of the same statement, not a cause, result or purpose.

none_fit.what: Emphatic particle 'surely' that marks the first clause as a firm assertion. No link type records emphasis, so it is left unrecorded rather than forced onto a relation.

cant_tell.what: The implied third person subject of the yiqtol 'will pursue' in cl0 (verb is third masculine plural). It has no slot in this verse.
cant_tell.why: The nearest plural candidates are the goodness and mercy pair, which are abstract nouns, and the verse does not state who pursues. No referent is chosen.
